releaseNotes:
🚀 v1.8.0 24/7 AI SMS Studio & Notifications Engine:
• 💬 24/7 AI Conversational SMS: Multi-turn SMS booking assistant answers questions, schedules arrivals, and interacts directly via phone SIM
• 🔔 Live Notifications & Activity Feed: Top-bar bell icon with real-time badges, category filters, and Android system notifications for AI calls, SMS chats, and emergencies
• 🛡️ 3-Way Incoming SMS Scope Gatekeeper: Enforce Strict mode (missed calls only), All Unknowns, or Voice-Only, protected by a Contacts Exemption shield
• 🚐 Mobile Field Trade vs. 🏪 In-Shop Studio: Customized scheduling windows for traveling trades vs exact time slots and directions for storefronts
• 🧹 Clean Voice Hub UI: Replaced redundant text template input with clean Post-Call SIM SMS toggle
